name: mirror
description: Personal AI work intelligence desktop application

scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend && npm run dev:frontend
scripts.dev:frontend: npm install && npm run build -w @mirror/contracts && npm run dev -w @mirror/desktop
scripts.prod:backend: docker compose --env-file backend/.env.production -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --build api worker minio
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mirror/contracts && npm run build -w @mirror/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @mirror/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @mirror/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
